integrity.proof_scope: All k>=0, ordered nonnegative summands, with independent finite checks only as supporting evidence
integrity.provenance: Original derivation from the base-four digit-carry transitions; no authorship or external certification asserted

scientific_limitations: The exact counts are for base-four prefix intervals and dilation three. The global count is Theta with sharp exponent, not an arbitrary-cutoff equivalent. The numerical covered-count recurrence is recorded in OEIS A007052 under other interpretations. Full publication priority is not established.
title: Sharp coverage, uniqueness, and multiplicity laws for a dilated Moser–de Bruijn sumset
